scope: private Windows failure-only startup trace collection

edits.before:
catch { Write-Host "Could not retain crash-dump receipt: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
}

transformation.method: Apply each unique literal before/after replacement in order; invert the same replacements in reverse order.

boundaries.processHandle: Borrow the already-retained Process object's original Handle query result; never reopen a PID. Confirm handle PID and creation FILETIME against the saved UTC StartTime, then confirm signaled exit using a zero-time wait.
boundaries.sourceBinding: Lowercase 40-hex GITHUB_SHA and canonical decimal PID/FILETIME form the one fixed parent GetTempPathW filename. Every complete projected row must match the tuple exactly.
boundaries.sourceRead: Only one fixed non-reparse disk file, no write/delete sharing, final handle path equality, at most 16,384 bytes, file identity/size/time before and after read, observed EOF and successful handle disposal before exposing bytes or hash.
boundaries.archive: CreateNew raw file and typed summary under existing OutDir; no overwrite/retry/delete. Read back the raw bytes through the new handle. Projection requires confirmed raw retention.
boundaries.parsing: ASCII JSONL; exact eight keys, no duplicates/unknown fields; strict numeric/string/boolean types; 64 records, 512 bytes per row, 63 ordinary records, canonical FILETIME, contiguous sequence and terminal trace-limit.
boundaries.partialTail: A complete stable file snapshot may contain an incomplete final JSONL record. Retain/hash all exact bytes; project only the preceding validated complete prefix, explicitly marked partial. A malformed/foreign complete row suppresses all row projection.
boundaries.projection: First eight and last sixteen validated complete rows, at most 24, explicit omissions. Fixed names/enums/booleans/numerics only. Complete marker-inclusive UTF-8 console envelope <=8,192 bytes or fixed overflow fallback.
boundaries.errorIsolation: Original primary ErrorRecord assignment/rethrow is unchanged. Collector invoked only after original cleanup in a separate guarded block; its file/parser/console failures remain secondary.
unchanged: Launch, process acquisition and existing Handle accessor evaluation order
Original deadlines, UIA/native actions, assertions, success report and screenshots
Original retained-process stop and drag-trace retention order
Original catch failure reporting and exact ErrorRecord rethrow

limits: No PowerShell parsing, C# compilation, .NET/Win32/file IO/UIA/native execution performed here.
Native writer and this collector use each process's GetTempPathW; a missing parent-side file cannot establish that Configure was not entered.
No finalized native footer; a complete JSONL stream does not prove startup completion or absence of later attempted/dropped markers.
The contention boolean reports only contention known through that row; no final total is inferred.
Returned markers occur only where source control reaches them; a missing marker cannot prove a callee did not return.
Synchronous file observation has bounded bytes/records, not a guaranteed wall-time bound.
A read-time stable snapshot is retained; no uninterrupted pathname immutability or final-cause claim is made.
